🚚 Delivery

Where we deliver, and when

Fudgio delivers across Lahore only. Everything is baked to order, so the box that reaches you was made that day.

📍

Lahore, city-wide

DHA, Gulberg, Model Town, Johar Town, Bahria, Askari, Cantt, Iqbal Town and the areas between them.

⏰

Same or next day

Order before 2pm and we usually deliver the same evening. After that it moves to the next day.

💵

Cash on arrival

Pay the rider in cash. Please keep close to the exact amount where you can.

📦

Free over Rs 2,500

Below that a delivery fee of Rs 150 applies, shown in your cart before you order.

Delivery charges

A flat Rs 150 anywhere in Lahore, and free once your order passes Rs 2,500. The exact figure is always shown in your cart and again on the checkout page before you place the order — you will never be surprised by it at the door.

Not in Lahore?

Not yet. Brownies are at their best within a day of coming out of the oven, and we would rather not ship something that arrives dry. If you are elsewhere in Pakistan, tell us where — we do read it, and it is how we decide where to go next.

If something goes wrong

If your box arrives damaged or late enough to be a problem, contact us the same day with your order number and we will make it right. Our number and email are on the contact page, and you can check your order status any time on the tracking page.
